scripts.kill: taskkill /F /IM SEVEN.exe /IM pythonw.exe /IM python.exe /IM Electron.exe /T 2>nul 1>nul & timeout /t 3 > nul
scripts.dev: npm run kill-dev-ports && SET SEVEN_BACKEND_EXTERNALLY_STARTED=1 && concurrently "npm run backend:dev" "npm run frontend:dev" "npm run electron:dev"
scripts.kill-dev-ports: node -e "try { const p = require('child_process').execSync('netstat -ano').toString().split('\n').find(l => l.includes(':5173') && l.includes('LISTENING')); if (p) { const pid = p.trim().split(/\s+/).pop(); if (pid && !isNaN(pid)) require('child_process').execSync('taskkill /F /PID ' + pid, {stdio:'ignore'}); } } catch(e) {}"
scripts.build:frontend: python scripts/build_app_manifest.py && cd frontend && npm run build
